## Description of Changes

Please provide a brief explanation of what this pull request changes, why it is needed, and any non-obvious design decisions.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds operational intelligence functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring / Code Quality improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Pluggable Provider adapter (Maps, AI, Storage)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's TypeScript and linting standards.
- [ ] I have written automated tests covering new business logic or calculations.
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally with 0 errors.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with 0 errors.
- [ ] No proprietary API keys or secrets are required for default local execution.
- [ ] Any test data used is 100% synthetic (zero real PHI/PII).
